Tara: Heads-up: visitor from MossWorks arriving ~3:40pm with a mini greenhouse terrarium (glass dome) + a flight case with a prototype mic for a short demo. Need careful staging, a temp badge, and the maker table reserved if possible. :herb: :ear:
Elliot: Maker table would be ideal since it has matting and power. Suggest we avoid the soft couches because of glass. Also request Facilities for a hand if the case is heavy.
FrontDeskBot: Delivery logged: 1x glass terrarium (label: 'MossWorks - fragile') + 1x flight case (prototype mic). Location: Receiving Rack D. Temp badge color: silver. Visitor checklist: ID scan, silver sticker, sign visitor log, escort option. Facilities notified for 3:35pm.
Gwen: Quick poll: react :thumbsup: to reserve maker table 3:35-4:05, :thumbsdown: if you need it. I can move my soldering gear if needed.
Marco: :thumbsup:
Elliot: :thumbsup: I'll clear the bench and move the magnifier lamp.
Tara: Also FYI the terrarium has live moss and a small LED light — please avoid bright direct lights and cut the demo time to ~10 mins to reduce humidity concerns. No open flames or incense nearby (allergy note).
FrontDeskBot: Note added to delivery log: "live moss + LED; avoid direct bright lights; no flames/incense; demo max 10 mins". Temp badge color set to silver. Facilities ETA 3:35 confirmed.
Gwen: I'll put a laminated "Maker table reserved 3:35-4:05" sign and a cardboard mat under the terrarium when moved. Can someone bring a small towel?
Marco: I'll grab a towel from the kitchen and bring an ESD-safe mat for the flight case.
Elliot: Facilities will assist at Receiving Rack D and wheel the flight case over on a small dolly.
Tara: I'll meet them at concierge and escort to the maker table. Thanks everyone. Please keep the demo short and I'll pack the terrarium back into its case after.
FrontDeskBot: Delivery log updated and terrarium flagged fragile. Maker table reservation requested; sign posted. Visitor badge: silver.
Gwen: All set here 60a see you at 3:35.
_meta: thread coordinating a visitor bringing a fragile terrarium and demo kit, reserving the maker table, silver temp badge, facilities assistance, and allergy/handling notes
